@pohly the apidiff test failed due to 
```
Incompatible changes:
- ./logs/api/v1.AddFeatureGates: changed from func(k8s.io/component-base/featuregate.MutableFeatureGate) error to func(k8s.io/component-base/featuregate.MutableVersionedFeatureGate) error
```
It should still be compatible as there was only one same implementation of interface `MutableFeatureGate` and `MutableVersionedFeatureGate`: `compoennt-base/featuregate.featureGate`

> It should still be compatible as there was only one same implementation of interface MutableFeatureGate and MutableVersionedFeatureGate: compoennt-base/featuregate.featureGate

That makes assumptions about what consumers are passing.

If they do this or something like it, it will not compile:
```Go
var featuregate MutableFeatureGate
featuregate = <...>
AddFeatureGates(featuregate)
```

You also cannot assume that there is only a single implementation of an interface. That has to be enforced with an unexported method and prevents implementations outside of the package itself, which wasn't done for `MutableFeatureGate` and `MutableVersionedFeatureGate`.

Having said that, I'm not against making this change. In practice it's probably (but not necessarily!) okay.

> > It should still be compatible as there was only one same implementation of interface MutableFeatureGate and MutableVersionedFeatureGate: compoennt-base/featuregate.featureGate
>

> 
> Having said that, I'm not against making this change. In practice it's probably (but not necessarily!) okay.

Yes, I didn't articulate that well. There currently only have one implementation. Though not strictly compatible, should be okay to change in practice.
